text:
maria - Sales: ACME wants a short hybrid POC (hosted + private agent). They sent CAIQ + DPA markups. Urgent asks: 1) exact telemetry leaving private agent by default, 2) DSAR delete proof workflow & attestation, 3) whether SCCs/SCC sentence needed for cross-border test data, 4) quick POC price for 2 nodes for 10 days. Need to reply tomorrow.

leo - Security: Short: private agent -> heartbeat + anonymized metrics only. No prompts/responses exfil by default. We can bind to customer KMS, TLS1.2+, AES-256. Will prepare a control map for their CAIQ IDs.

maria - Sales: They explicitly asked: "Will token logs or trimmed prompt fragments leave our VPC?"

kevin - Eng Platform: No trimmed fragments. Outbound payloads are limited to `{heartbeat_ts, node_id, metrics_agg, opt_hashed_counts}` when `usage_reporting=false` it's just heartbeat + metrics. If they enable diag mode we only send hashed token counts and sample sizes, never raw text. Example flag: `redwood-agentctl set telemetry.usage_reporting false`.

anya - Legal: On the DPA redlines: we can accept a 10- or 14-day retention for POCs; propose 14 by default. For DSARs during POC: customer acts as controller on private; we'll provide export utilities + a signed scrub-cert (HMAC) after deletion. I'll draft a short addendum with a scrub-cert template and SCCs sentence for cross-border testing.

jess - Solutions: Pricing: DMing hourly for 2x A10G-equivalent nodes and a 10-day flat POC quote. Note: Dedicated committed pricing needs min 1 month; POC hourly billed in 7-day blocks. Also estimating hosted token costs if they route traffic to hosted for parts of the test.

leo - Security: For CAIQ mapping I'll call out: network egress control, logging control, key mgmt, RBAC. Also recommend an allowlist of control-plane endpoints they can lock to. I will upload a short answers doc.

maria - Sales: Action list: @anya draft 14d addendum + scrub-cert, @leo CAIQ mapping + allowed endpoints, @kevin config snippet + `redwood-agentctl` commands, @jess price DM + 10/14-day quote. I'll stitch together and reply.

kevin - Eng Platform: DSAR scrub flow (private): `1) redwood-agentctl export --subject <id> --out file.json` -> review -> `2) redwood-agentctl scrub --subject <id> --confirm` -> produces `scrub-cert.txt` (HMAC signed). Will include exact RBAC roles required.

anya - Legal: Draft in progress. Will include SCCs blurb: "For cross-border test data, customer may require SCCs; Redwood will sign the commercial SCC addendum where applicable." Uploading in ~3h.

maria - Sales: Great, thanks. If any of you need more time flag it here and I'll push timeline with the customer. audit-bot: thread created for tracking.
